name: Fairy Dust
description: Fairy dust swirls across the battlefield, beckoning forth legendary tales. What was once just a Fantasy becomes reality.
effect:
- Fairy Types lose weakness to either Poison or Steel types, chosen at the start of the round.
- Fairy-type, Dragon-type, Steel-type and Psychic-type moves gain +1 Damage.
- Fairy, Psychic and Grass-types regain 1 Will at the end of each round.
